title: Dynamic Shift Environment Configuration
description: JSON Schema defining the configuration contract for dynamic shift environments. Used to validate shift parameters before environment initialization and to log configuration provenance.

shift_step.description: The environment step number at which the dynamic shift occurs. Must be within the episode horizon.

shift_type.description: The nature of the dynamic shift to be applied.

magnitude.description: The magnitude of the shift (0.0 = no change, 1.0 = maximal disruption).

target_env_id.description: The Gymnasium environment ID to which the shift is applied (e.g., 'CartPole-v1').

shift_config.description: Specific parameters for the shift type.

reward_delta.description: Additive or multiplicative factor applied to rewards post-shift.

transition_noise.description: Noise level added to transition probabilities.

validation_seed.description: Seed used to ensure reproducibility of the shift injection for testing.
